from_notes: Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 = One Nation One Election: inserts Article 82A; amends Article 83 and Article 172.
x: The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 is the 'One Nation One Election' Bill: it inserts Article 82A and amends Articles 83 and 172 to hold Lok Sabha and State Assembly elections together (now with the JPC under P.P. Chaudhary). Cooperative societies got constitutional status by the 97th Amendment (2011), the NCBC by the 102nd Amendment (2018), and Election Tribunals were abolished by the 19th Amendment (1966).
source: Praveen CA-360 Sep 2026 magazine p.15 (Constitution 129th Amendment Bill, 2024 and UT Laws Amendment Bill, 2024 'relating to One Nation–One Election': JPC chair P.P. Chaudhary, 39 members); Rocket Polity 01 p.64 (ONOE needs amendment of Arts 83, 85, 172, 174, 356)

from_notes: Launched by the National Commission for Women in Jalandhar, Punjab (chairperson Vijaya Rahatkar). Yashoda AI: AI awareness and digital literacy for women.
x: 'Yashoda AI' was launched by the National Commission for Women (chairperson Vijaya Rahatkar) in Jalandhar, Punjab, with 'She Serves', to build women's AI, digital and cyber-safety skills. The Ministry of Women and Child Development is only NCW's nodal ministry; the Home and IT ministries did not launch it.
source: Praveen CA-360 Aug 2026 magazine p.21 (NCW launches 'Yashoda AI' in Jalandhar under Chairperson Vijaya Rahatkar; NCW Act 1990, est. 1992, nodal MWCD); Praveen CA-360 Aug 2026 one-liners p.6
